claim_scope: Same-developer, shared-source retrieval and ambiguity audit. Not independent clinical accuracy, eligibility, user outcomes or time savings.

selection_freeze.limit: Local hash/timestamp, not trusted external preregistration. Selection is purposive and developer authored.

expectation_freeze.state: All selected source material read; explicit expectations frozen. No selected navigator queries executed yet.
expectation_freeze.scope: Same-developer source conformance, not independent clinical truth or trusted external preregistration.

source_verification: Whole original file hashes, original workbook cells, and complete selected/context mapping excerpts verified before queries.

clinical_promotion_assessment.independent_clinical_truth: Unavailable for the full association set; no clinical accuracy or false-positive rate calculated.
clinical_promotion_assessment.observed_static_framing: Condition status, candidate-gene labels and explicit non-eligibility notice are retained. No explicit claim that each candidate gene/variant/family is approved was identified in reviewed template/card text.
clinical_promotion_assessment.remaining_risk: POLYGENIC and RelatedGenes qualifiers are omitted from per-gene details. Candidate genes appear alongside condition-level approval. That semantic loss can support overinterpretation; comprehension and real-world decisions were not studied.
clinical_promotion_assessment.source_sharing: Builder and audit share original snapshots; HPO and ClinVar can share upstream records. Correct transcription is not independent biological truth. Same developer authored selection, expectations and evaluation.
